messages:
Priya: Quick sync — bringing Sprintline weekly health matrix here. We saw an error-rate jump this morning, need a fast triage. TL;DR: 5xx spike + timeouts + some rate-limit hits. Posting top offender URIs and sample traces.
Jamal: copying. can you paste the numbers? :eyes:
Priya: Yes — metrics from 00:00–06:00 UTC:
- overall error rate: 3.8% (baseline 0.4%)
- 5xx: 2.5% (primarily 502/503)
- timeouts (gateway): 0.9%
- rate-limit responses (429): 0.4%
Priya: Top failing endpoints by error volume:
1) POST /v1/generate (36% of errors)
2) POST /v1/embeddings (18%)
3) POST /v1/chat/stream (12%)
4) GET /v1/model/status (10%)
5) POST /v1/session/kv-sync (8%)
Priya: Sample trace snippets (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] req_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=runtime-io msg="upstream reset"
[2026-03-20T03:14:24Z] req_id=abc124 route=/v1/generate latency=3.4s timeout=true
[2026-03-20T03:16:01Z] req_id=def456 route=/v1/embeddings status=429 qps=48
```
Elsa: thx — looks like the generate path is where kernel timeouts + upstream resets happen. Any recent deploys to runtime? @infra-bot do we have a rollout record?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prod rollout job #r-2026-03-20-0312 completed at 2026-03-20T03:12:07Z. Variants touched: runtime-v2.4, batching-service-v1.9. No automatic rollback triggered.
Jamal: that matches the spike timing. Priority: isolate 502s vs timeouts. I'll check connection errors between batching-service and runtime nodes and KV cache eviction metrics.
Tomas: Sprintline is mid-onboarding; this looks like a renewal-risk signal if it persists. Priya, can we message their CSM and offer a mitigation plan?
Priya: yes, I'll ping them after we have immediate mitigations. Proposed immediate mitigations:
- temporarily route Sprintline traffic to fallback model (runtime-v2.3) for POST /v1/generate
- increase batching-service timeout threshold from 3s -> 6s for affected routes
- add a short-term throttle at edge for high concurrency API keys (limit to 40 qps)
Elsa: I can push a quick routing change to route 10% traffic to v2.3 as canary, then 100% if stable. Also will enable verbose runtime logs for 1 hour.
Jamal: I'll create a quick rollback play: scale up runtime-v2.3 pool + pin Sprintline to dedicated nodes if available. Also capturing kernel OOM/stack traces now.
Priya: Customer impact note to CSM: "We're observing higher error rates on generation calls this morning due to a backend runtime rollout. We're applying a temporary fallback and throttles; we'll update in 30m." Tomas: :ok_hand:
infra-bot: alert-summary: 90% of 502s originate from 3 runtime hosts in us-west-2 cluster (host ids: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0a1b2c3e, i-0a1b2c3f). Leads: Jamal, Elsa.
Elsa: host-level logs show repeated kernel-level EPIPE on runtime-io process, and one node has elevated CPU and swap churn. Suspect noisy neighbor/quantization kernel regression in runtime-v2.4.
Jamal: action items:
- Jamal: scale and isolate affected hosts, roll Sprintline to v2.3 canary (ETA 12m)
- Elsa: enable extra logs + check kernel regressions (ETA 20m)
- Priya: notify Sprintline CSM + update slack in 30m (ETA 10m)
- Tomas: prepare renewal-ops note if customer asks for timeline (standby)
Priya: I'll post status updates to the customer and add to the weekly health doc. Anything else? :thinking_face:
Tomas: pls add the spend/excess billing note if we shift them to dedicated nodes — finance may need a heads-up.
Jamal: small follow-up: discovered that batch-size heuristics for Sprintline had a sudden workload shape change (avg seq len +40%). That increases KV cache pressure and latency — explains timeouts.
Priya: Good find. I'll coordinate a brief enablement doc for Sprintline engineers to optimize payload size and retry policies.
Elsa: I'll start a revert path if errors persist. Reverting runtime-v2.4 -> v2.3 validated on staging already.
Priya: Thanks team. Will update thread with verification metrics after canary. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: started remediation run — will post logs here.
infra-bot: action-log: remediation started by Jamal at 2026-03-20T03:19:09Z; canary route applied (10% -> v2.3).
